name: Orbweaver
description: The cave's first arrival, and the biggest pale shape in it: an abdomen the size of the rest of the animal, cream, with the dark folium cross an orb weaver actually wears painted down it — the one marking a player will know from a garden, which is exactly why it is here. Three lines of its own silk still run off the back, because this body is never off its web; it brings the web with it. Long banded legs with pale tips, a slow heavy gait, and a value structure the enraged state turns inside out: pale shell to dark, dark cross to lit. Gameplay radius 40.

enraged.description: Half its health gone: the shell darkens to the stone it stands on and the folium lights up — the same drawing with its values swapped, which is what says the fight changed without a bar.

pluck.description: a heavy walk with the front pair doing something else: the body barely travels while the three anchor lines off the abdomen are drawn and let go, which is what a spider does instead of shouting
